VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the report claims all 23 tests pass and describes the fix, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The acceptance criteria explicitly requires that "all 23 tests pass," which demands objective verification, not self-attestation. The absence of CI logs, diffs, or test results means the claims cannot be independently validated.
